purpose: Technical test bed for relighting and grounding. Stock footage, not the artist's own performance, so identity-drift risk is acceptable here and generative relighting may be evaluated freely before it is trusted on the artist's own footage.
source_color_tagging: TAGGED, unlike the proof-of-concept plate which was untagged and assumed sRGB. Limited-range bt709 must be expanded on decode; do not reuse the untagged full-range assumption.
source_audio_note: No audio stream at all. Music-timeline sync for this shot cannot come from camera audio and must be defined against the song, or the shot must be treated as free-timed.

source_shutter.status: not present in metadata; preserve photographed blur

source_white_balance.status: not in metadata; plate reads neutral-to-slightly-cool flat frontal studio light

framing.grounding_note: No feet, legs, seat or floor contact appear in frame. Contact shadow and floor interaction are UNAVAILABLE as grounding cues for this shot. Believability must come from lighting direction and colour match, perspective and scale match, depth of field, and edge integration.

camera.warning: Do not inherit the proof-of-concept values (52 mm, 4.3 m, height 1.02 m). Those were solved for a seated full figure at a wide framing. This is a standing bust shot and requires its own lens, height, distance and horizon estimate.

selection.reason: Chosen for the relighting comparison: covers the hand-to-ear/hair gesture, giving self-occlusion and moving hair, which stresses temporal stability. A static bust would flatter a bad method.

delivery.note: Inherits the video-level delivery spec unless overridden. At 60000/1001 the mov timescale must be 60000 with 1001 ticks per frame; hdr_mux.py derives this from source_frame_rate.
delivery.conform_decision: Resolved: preserve native 59.94 for this shot. It is a technical test bed for relighting, not a creative deliverable, so no retime is applied and no resampling artefacts are introduced into the comparison. The 24/1 project default does not apply here. NOTE 59.94 -> 24 is not an integer ratio (2.4975:1) and would require frame resampling at 1:1 speed; the artist shoots 24 natively so his own footage is unaffected.

keying.note: Inherited proof-of-concept thresholds as a STARTING POINT only. This plate has a brighter, more saturated backing and, critically, no green wardrobe (dark suit, white shirt), so despill may be applied globally here unlike the proof of concept. Verify on the test frames before the full run.
keying.hint_source: Derived by scripts/calibrate_key.py from the plate border; see logs/key_calibration.json
keying.despill_note: All despill is the manual pass: CorridorKey's despill_strength affects only result['processed'], not the result['fg'] this pipeline reads. Gain 100 with max 1.0 reaches the full average-limit correction on subtle rim spill; the legacy gain of 2 was calibrated for the proof-of-concept plate's ~0.5 excesses and left 20% of edge pixels green-positive here. Safe to be aggressive because the excess metric self-gates: skin is red-dominant (negative excess) and neutral fabric is near zero.
